Blockchain technology works like a shared digital record book that is not controlled by any single person or company. Instead, it is maintained by a network of computers, which makes the system secure and transparent. Every time a transaction happens, it is grouped with others into a "block." Once this block is checked and added to the chain, it cannot be changed or deleted. This is because each block is cryptographically linked to the one before it, creating a strong chain that is very difficult to hack or tamper with.
